name: Gareb
title: One of David's Mighty Men
summary: Gareb was an Itrite who served as one of King David's mighty warriors, known as 'the Thirty'. He is mentioned in the list of David's heroes in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles. The name Gareb is also associated with a hill near Jerusalem mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: Gareb is listed as one of David's thirty mighty warriors, an elite group of soldiers who served King David with great bravery.

keyEvents.title: Identified as an Itrite
keyEvents.description: Gareb is described as an Itrite, indicating his origin from a clan or place called Jeter or Jattir.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the Chronicles' roster
keyEvents.description: Gareb is also mentioned in the parallel list of David's heroes in 1 Chronicles, confirming his place among David's most trusted warriors.

keyEvents.title: The Hill of Gareb in Jeremiah's prophecy
keyEvents.description: The prophet Jeremiah mentions the hill of Gareb in a prophecy about Jerusalem's future rebuilding and expansion, where the city will extend to this hill.
